Tuong (Tướng) belongs to Vietnam's national climbing-card tradition. The closely related game Tiến Lên (Go Forward) is considered the national card game of Vietnam and shares the same shedding-and-climbing family as Zheng Shangyou and President. The genre spread beyond Vietnam, including to the USA after the Vietnam War where it is sometimes known as Thirteen or Viet Cong.

items.text: No twos in sequences: Twos cannot be used in sequences; straights run from 3 up to ace only.
Stacking: When all but one have passed, the last player to play may continue with successively higher combinations of the same type until unable.
